title: Auto-Replay Farming Guide
subject: Pick what you want, set the loop, walk away — every chapter simulated, per hour

method.summary: Simulated with the game's own battle engine on the current build: 63 loops (every chapter, each League counted as one loop), 10 laps each per team. Money: the best of 2 strong endgame teams, because a faster lap is more money. Battle XP: Dialga (Lv 100, rank 5) in front and 5 Pokémon at Lv 40–70 behind it; every team member gets each win's XP even if it never fights, with +10% for the one that fought. Candy XP is counted as the XP the dropped candies give. Exp. Candy Big gives 810K XP for ₽96K (8.4 XP per ₽, the same in every region); buying candy adds only 1.9–3.9M XP/h, so the Kanto League stays on top. Candy drops are random, so the candy rankings shift from run to run.

algorithm.goal: Rank every auto-replay loop by money per hour, battle XP per hour, candy XP per hour and a mixed score.
algorithm.engine: The game's own battle engine at build 3bdd8140e1
steps: Enumerate the 63 loops: every chapter, with each League as one loop.
Run 10 laps of each loop with each of the 2 strong endgame money teams; keep the faster lap.
Run 10 laps with Dialga Lv 100 rank 5 in front and 5 Pokémon at Lv 40–70 behind; count every member's XP, +10% for the one that fought.
Count candy drops as the XP those candies give.
Divide each total by the lap time to get the hourly rate; the mixed goal scores each loop against the best loop for each of the three.
Also add the XP bought by spending the loop's money on Exp. Candy Big (810K XP for ₽96K).

parameters.teamXpShare: every member gets each win's XP; +10% for the one that fought

acceptance.money: A faster lap is more money; the money ranking uses the faster of the two teams.
acceptance.candy: Candy drops are random, so the candy-XP order moves between runs.
